old: When my own daughter first went out with a yellow ticket,
new: When my own daughter first went out with a yellow ticket, the prostitute's pass,
reason: The 'yellow ticket' is a period term a modern listener may not know, and the whole scene turns on what it means.
The landlady is named here for the first time, so a listener has no way to know who Praskovya Pavlovna is.
The same merchant is called Afanasy Ivanovitch later in this letter and again in Chapter 4, so 'Vassily' sounds like a different person.

old: even before the Fast of Our Lady if it can be managed
new: even before the Fast of Our Lady in August if it can be managed
reason: Adding the month turns an obscure church-calendar reference into an actual date.

old: a Lett with a German master
new: a Latvian peasant with a German master
reason: 'Lett' is an obscure old word, and heard aloud it sounds like 'let'.

old: Lots of our guys have dealt with her.
new: Lots of our fellows have dealt with her.
reason: 'Guys' is modern slang that breaks the period world.

old: whom the wretched little creature constantly beat
new: whom the wretched little old woman constantly beat
reason: The sentence has just mentioned Lizaveta, so 'the wretched little creature' could be heard as her rather than the pawnbroker who does the beating.

old: One apartment on the first floor was wide open
new: One apartment on the second floor was wide open
reason: He is climbing to the fourth floor and later says the painters are 'two floors below', which only fits if they are on the second floor.
